messages.author: 96ac8657240877c2
messages.subject: histograms in ggplot2_0.9.2.99
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to reproduce a simple histogram (taken from http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/geom_histogram.html): 

set.seed(5689)
movies <- movies[sample(nrow(movies), 1000), ]
# Simple examples
qplot(rating, data=movies, geom="histogram")

but it fails with this error:

stat_bin: binwidth defaulted to range/30. Use 'binwidth = x' to adjust this.
Error in UseMethod("fullseq") : 
  no applicable method for 'fullseq' applied to an object of class "c('double', 'numeric')"
Error in UseMethod("scale_dimension") : 
  no applicable method for 'scale_dimension' applied to an object of class "NULL"


The same error is generated when trying to reproduce histograms that used to be OK in previous versions of ggplot2. Could anybody point out the right way to generate it?

Thanks in advance,
